positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Served as Software Engineer for an international toll road builder and operator with assets in Australia and North America
-Utilized Golang, Python, Typescript and Java Spring along with several AWS technologies (API Gateway, Lambda, EC2/ECS, S3, CloudFront, CloudFormation, Aurora, DynamoDB) to automate License Plate Identification, Vehicle Occupancy Detection, Static/Dynamic Pricing, and other aspects of road tolling
-Developed portal using Angular 7+, TypeScript, and other frontend technologies
-Leveraged Swagger Codegen to generate service code on Typescript frontend and Golang microservice backend
-Provided on-call support and monitored the health and activity of the system via Datadog
-Supported infrastructure and releases required to process hundreds of thousands transactions per month

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Delivered full stack services to a global insurance brokerage SaaS product
-Developed ETL process to integrate Salesforce data with other internal products via microservices, RabbitMQ messaging, OData, REST API’s, & custom IBM UniVerse DB programs
-Built & maintained UI features in Angular/Node.js, backend services via C#/ASP.NET Web API & Azure SQL DB
-Integrated with Stripe, SendGrid, & store 3rd party inventory via Elasticsearch

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Served as Software Data Engineer on the Support Engineering Team for an enterprise AdTech SaaS performance marketing software that processes billions of transactions per month
-Implemented data integration via SQL Server stored procedures to deliver reporting data from SQL Server, AWS S3/Athena, Aurora, & Redshift
-Optimized stored-procedure queries using Execution Query Plan tool on SSMS, rewriting redundant queries, & providing hints to use existing indexes
-Led GDPR data deletion/scrub effort of PII from all relevant data repositories for compliance
-Implemented features and bug-fixes in C#/ASP.NET & React framework supporting SOAP and REST API’s
